name: qiqihar
description: A bilingual four-player co-op browser game where tiny pixel cats try to hiss together.

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @qiqihar/shared && concurrently -k -n server,client -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w @qiqihar/server" "npm run dev -w @qiqihar/client"
scripts.dev:lan: npm run build -w @qiqihar/shared && concurrently -k -n server,client -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w @qiqihar/server" "npm run dev -w @qiqihar/client -- --host 0.0.0.0"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @qiqihar/shared && npm run build -w @qiqihar/server && npm run build -w @qiqihar/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @qiqihar/shared && npm run typecheck -ws --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build -w @qiqihar/shared && npm run build -w @qiqihar/server && vitest run
scripts.test:browser: npm run build -w @qiqihar/shared && npm run build -w @qiqihar/server && vitest run --config vitest.browser.config.ts
